name: gandalf
description: Runs gandalf's quality gates and fails the workflow on a red verdict

docker.customCommand: sh -c 'git config --global --add safe.directory "*" && git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch v0.4.0 https://github.com/fabiocicerchia/gandalf /tmp/gandalf && git clone --quiet $REPO_URL /tmp/src && cd /tmp/src && PYTHONPATH=/tmp/gandalf/src python3 -m gandalf --no-llm --no-html --no-trend --out-dir /tmp/reports'
